newsitem.headline: TABLE - USA WASTE SERVICES INC Q2 SHR RISES.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE - Prior period financial statements have been restated to reflect the merger transactions with Western Waste Industries consummated on May 7, 1996, Grand Central Sanitation Inc consummated on May 15, 1996, and Sanifill Inc consummated on August 30, 1996, accounted for as poolings of interests.

The 1996 results are pro forma to exclude pre-tax charges aggregating $51.1 million for merger costs and other nonrecurring expenses relating principally to the merger with Western Waste Industries in May 1996. Those merger and other nonrecurring expenses decreased after tax earnings per share for the 1996 period by $0.29.
The 1996 pro forma results also assume an effective tax rate of 40 percent.
1997 per share figures include after-tax interest expense addback to net income of about $3.2 million for certain convertible subordinated notes.
